data.name: Girish
data.gender_notes: Girish is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit giri, 'mountain', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the mountain'. Its root is Sanskrit giri + īśa. An epithet of Shiva. Girish is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of the mountain; Shiva”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Girish expresses “Lord of the mountain; Shiva”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit giri, 'mountain', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the mountain'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Girish total 43, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
